claims.evidence: No photo shows country of origin or prior use.
Photo 0 shows a D750 box, but the actual body is not visible outside packaging; a NIKKOR LENS 50 box is also in the background.
Only packaging is shown; the camera body itself is not visible.
Photo 2 shows wrapped items; no power-on or shutter test is shown.
Photo 0 box and Photo 1 manual read Nikon D750.

risks.risk: The actual camera body may be damaged, non-genuine, or a different model inside the sealed box.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the camera body outside the box, showing the lens mount, sensor, LCD, and top plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-working or unknown-condition body

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have a high shutter count or mechanical fault.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, and firing the shutter, or a screenshot of the shutter count.

risks.risk: The NIKKOR LENS 50 box in the background may mean a lens is included, missing, or damaged, contradicting a body-only sale.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens if included, or confirmation that the sale is body only.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only with no lens

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, and other accessories may be missing or non-genuine.
risks.proof: A photo of all accessories unwrapped and together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only without accessories

risks.risk: No warranty or purchase date is visible, so the item may be out of warranty or have no proof of purchase.
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt or warranty card.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual Nikon D750 body outside the box.
Video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter.
Photo of any lens and accessories unwrapped.
Photo of the receipt or warranty card.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D750 from the box and manual, so a worst-case price is possible; the body and function are unseen, so it is priced as non-working until proven otherwise.
